name: bytedance/seed-speech/tts/2.0
display_name: Bytedance Seed Speech Text to Speech
description: Seed Speech Tts 2.0 is Bytedance's text-to-speech AI model. Generate human-like voiceovers with expressive intonation, multilingual support, and customizable voice characteristics.

text.title: Text
examples: Hello, this is a test of ByteDance TTS 2.0 speech synthesis.
text.description: The text to synthesize into speech.

pitch.title: Pitch
pitch.description: Voice pitch shift in semitones. 0 is normal pitch, -12 lowers by one octave, 12 raises by one octave.

speed.title: Speed
speed.description: Speech speed. 1.0 is normal speed, 0.5 is half speed, 2.0 is double speed.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: Voice to use for synthesis. The preset name encodes the voice and its supported language codes. 'mixed_en_zh' means the voice can seamlessly blend English and Chinese; separate codes (e.g. 'en_zh') mean the voice supports each language independently.

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Volume. 1.0 is normal volume, 0.5 is half, 2.0 is double.

language.title: Language
language.description: Force the text to be read as a single language, disabling automatic language detection. Leave unset for automatic detection (including seamless Chinese/English mixing on bilingual voices). Codes: zh (Chinese), en (English), ja (Japanese), es-mx (Mexican Spanish), id (Indonesian), pt-br (Brazilian Portuguese), ko (Korean), it (Italian), de (German), fr (French).

sample_rate.title: Sample Rate
sample_rate.description: Sample rate of the output audio in Hz.

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output audio format. 'mp3' returns MP3 audio; 'opus' returns Opus audio in an Ogg container.

voice_instruction.title: Voice Instruction
examples: Speak in a warm, cheerful tone.
voice_instruction.description: Optional natural-language instruction that steers the delivery (tone, emotion, pace, volume), e.g. 'Speak in a cheerful tone' or 'Could you speak a bit slower?'. It is not spoken aloud and does not affect billing.

id.description: Unique identifier for the generation task.

error.description: Error message if the task failed. Empty on success.

model.description: Model ID used for the prediction.

status.description: Status of the task: pending, running, completed, failed, or timeout.

url.description: The URL where the generated content can be downloaded from.

content_type.description: The MIME type of the output file.

outputs.description: Array of generated content. Empty when status is not completed.

readme:
# Bytedance Seed Speech Text to Speech

Seed Speech TTS 2.0 generates expressive, multilingual voiceovers in 10 languages, with pitch, speed, and volume control and a free-text `voice_instruction` for delivery.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | — | Text to speak. |
| `output_format` | `mp3` / `opus` | `mp3` | Output file format. |
| `sample_rate` | 8000 / 16000 / 22050 / 24000 / 32000 / 44100 / 48000 | 24000 | Output sample rate in Hz. |
| `volume` | number 0.5–2 | 1 | 0.5–2× loudness. |
| `voice` | `vivi_mixed_en_zh_ja_es_id` / `mindy_en_es_id_pt_zh` / `stokie_en` / `dacey_en` / `tim_en` / `kian_en_zh` / `cedric_en_zh` / `sophie_en_zh` / `jean_en_zh` / `magnus_en_zh` / `mabel_en_zh` / `nadia_en_zh` / `opal_en_zh` / `pearl_en_zh` / `quentin_en_zh` / `vienna_mixed_en_zh` / `alina_mixed_en_zh` / `corinne_mixed_en_zh` / `esther_mixed_en_zh` / `freya_mixed_en_zh` / `gigi_mixed_en_zh` / `holly_mixed_en_zh` / `lyla_mixed_en_zh` / `daisy_mixed_en_zh` / `tracy_es_zh` / `jess_ja_es_id_pt_en_zh` / `pinky_es_ko_mixed_en_zh` / `sweety_ja_es` / `sandy_es_mixed_en_zh` / `sven_de` / `minimi_ja` / `usseau_fr` / `felipe_es` / `han_id` / `martins_pt` / `enzo_it` / `shane_ko` / `bonnie_zh` / `felix_zh` / `celeste_zh` / `monkey_king_zh` | `stokie_en` | Preset voice; names list the languages each voice supports. |
| `pitch` | integer -12–12 | 0 | Semitones, −12 to 12. |
| `language` | `zh` / `en` / `ja` / `es-mx` / `id` / `pt-br` / `ko` / `it` / `de` / `fr` | — | Force the text to be read as a single language, disabling automatic language detection. |
| `voice_instruction` | string | — | How to say it, e.g. “excited sports commentator”. |
| `speed` | number 0.5–2 | 1 | 0.5–2× speaking rate. |

## Billing

$0.06 per started 1,000 characters of text, with a one-unit minimum.

| Text | Price |
|---|---|
| 200 characters | $0.06 |
| 1,000 characters | $0.06 |
| 2,500 characters | $0.18 |

Failed runs are not charged.

## Prompting

- Pick a voice whose language list includes the text's language.
